title: AI/ML Engineer Intern
description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic AI/ML Intern who has a strong interest in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Data Science. The candidate will work on developing data-driven applications and AI-powered solutions using Python and modern machine learning tools.

Responsibilities:

Develop and test AI and Machine Learning models using Python.
Clean, preprocess, and analyze datasets using Pandas and NumPy.
Create data visualizations using Matplotlib and Seaborn.
Work on machine learning and data science projects.
Build AI-powered applications for real-world problems.
Participate in developing and testing AI-based features.
Work with tools such as Jupyter Notebook, VS Code, Git, and GitHub.
Collaborate with team members to improve model performance and application functionality.
Research new AI/ML techniques and technologies.

Required Skills:

Good knowledge of Python.
Basic understanding of Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Data Science.
Knowledge of Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.
Understanding of data preprocessing and analysis.
Familiarity with Git and GitHub.
Problem-solving and analytical skills.
Willingness to learn new AI technologies.

Preferred Skills:

Experience developing AI/ML projects.
Knowledge of AI agents or generative AI.
Experience with resume analysis, recommendation systems, or conversational AI.
Basic understanding of speech-to-text or AI interview systems.

Education:
B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.

What You Will Work On:
The selected candidate may work on AI-powered applications involving data analysis, machine learning, intelligent automation, AI agents, and conversational AI systems. Experience with projects such as AI recruitment platforms, resume matching, candidate ranking, or AI-based interviews would be relevant.

Short version for a job portal

AI/ML Intern – Job Description

We are seeking a motivated Computer Science/AI student to join our team as an AI/ML Intern. The role involves developing Python-based AI and Machine Learning applications, analyzing datasets, building ML models, creating visualizations, and contributing to real-world AI projects. Candidates should have knowledge of Python, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Machine Learning, and Data Science, along with basic Git/GitHub experience. Practical AI/ML projects and knowledge of AI agents or Generative AI will be an advantage.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description: We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to architect and deploy predictive machine learning models. You will work extensively with Python, machine learning algorithms, deep learning (TensorFlow / PyTorch), SQL data warehouses, and Scikit-Learn. Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP) and containerization with Docker is a strong plus.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description: AvaHire is hiring a Senior Financial Analyst responsible for quantitative financial modeling, discounted cash flow (DCF) valuations, variance analysis, and executive forecasting. Must have mastery of advanced Excel, financial statement analysis, accounting principles, and Bloomberg Terminal or Capital IQ. CFA or MBA is preferred.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description: Looking for a versatile Full Stack Developer to build high-scale web applications. Key requirements include React, Node.js, TypeScript, REST APIs, and PostgreSQL. Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and microservices experience are highly desired.

title: Cloud & DevOps Engineer
description: Lead the modernization and scaling of our multi-region cloud infrastructure. Requires hands-on experience with AWS, Kubernetes (k8s), Docker, Terraform (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and Linux administration.

title: QA Automation Engineer
description: Responsible for designing and executing automated test suites, end-to-end regression frameworks, and API integration testing. Must have deep experience with Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, test automation architecture, and defect tracking in Jira.
